name: Template: Infrastructure & DevOps
description: Track infrastructure incidents, changes, and improvements. Each swimlane is a system; each card is a work item.

swimlanes.name: Production Kubernetes
swimlanes.notes: EKS 1.29. 3 node groups, 12 nodes. HPA on API and worker deployments. Primary production cluster.

swimlanes.name: CI/CD Pipeline
swimlanes.notes: GitLab CI on Kubernetes runners. Kaniko for image builds. p95 pipeline: 8 min. Zero DinD.

swimlanes.name: Database Cluster
swimlanes.notes: RDS PostgreSQL 16. Primary + 2 replicas. Nightly backups to S3. Point-in-time recovery enabled.

swimlanes.name: CDN & Edge
swimlanes.notes: CloudFront distribution. Edge caching for static assets and API responses. WAF rules enabled.

swimlanes.name: Monitoring Stack
swimlanes.notes: Prometheus + Grafana + Alertmanager + PagerDuty. Jaeger for distributed tracing.

swimlanes.name: Security Infrastructure
swimlanes.notes: Vault for secrets, Falco for runtime security, Trivy for image scanning. SOC 2 controls.

swimlanes.name: Staging Environment
swimlanes.notes: Mirror of production at 1/4 scale. Auto-deployed on merge to main. Seed data refreshed nightly.

swimlanes.name: Data Pipeline
swimlanes.notes: Airflow on EKS. 42 DAGs. Snowflake as warehouse. dbt for transformations. 500k events/hour peak.

swimlanes.name: DNS & Networking
swimlanes.notes: Route 53 for DNS. VPC peering across 3 accounts. Transit Gateway for on-prem connectivity.

swimlanes.name: Disaster Recovery
swimlanes.notes: Cross-region DR in eu-west-1. RPO: 1 hour. RTO: 4 hours. Quarterly failover drills required.
